summary: Bounded spending authority for one subject: per-action and rolling-window caps, allowed assets and allowed targets. Evaluated over each action and over the subject's trajectory within the window.

partialOrder.rule: B is not wider than A when B.denomination == A.denomination, B.perActionCap <= A.perActionCap, B.windowCap <= A.windowCap, B.windowSeconds >= A.windowSeconds, B.allowedAssets is a subset of A.allowedAssets (an absent list in A means unrestricted, in B means empty) and B.allowedTargets is a subset of A.allowedTargets.

verification.resultMeaning: the action is within the caps at execution time
trustAssumptions: the account module is the only path through which the subject can spend

verification.resultMeaning: no spend tool call exceeded the caps
trustAssumptions: the runtime is not under the subject's control

limitations: Caps in a denomination other than the asset's own depend on a price source; the price source is part of the trust assumptions.
